features: Sony STARVIS sensor with Tamron 3-9 mm lens
16 GB microSD internal storage for edge recording (optional up to 128 GB)
release_notes: Archived/EOL Advanced-line (2017 generation, © ABUS 08/2018) indoor IP dome 2 MPx — predecessor platform of the IPCA72510. Verified against the official ABUS product-sheet datasheet: Sony Starvis Exmor R + Sony Xarina DSP, Tamron 3.0-9.0 mm motor-zoom (3x optical), 1080p @ 30 fps, H.264/MJPEG, True WDR 120 dB, IR up to 20 m (12 LEDs), 35-96° FOV, IP24 / IK10 indoor, PoE 802.3af + 12V DC, 2-way audio (no built-in mic), 16 GB microSD (opt. 128 GB), 141x141x98 mm, 0.68 kg, min operating temp -10 °C. Aperture not stated on the datasheet (omitted). Sibling IPCA22500 remains excluded: identity and resolution unconfirmed.

frigate.notes: 2017 Advanced line (Sony/Tamron platform, not Hikvision OEM) — RTSP path undocumented. Use go2rtc ONVIF autodiscovery (onvif://{user}:{pass}@{ip}) to resolve the stream URL.
